## Description

Destroys in-world text that was created by [Create In-World Text](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/create%2Bin-world%2Btext).

## Snippet

```
Destroy In-World Text(Last Text ID);
```

## Properties

**Parameters**: ==_Text ID_==

> ==**Text ID**==
> _Type: **Text ID**, Default: **[Last Text ID](/wiki/articles/last+text+id)**_
